messages:
anya: Short follow-up from today's KV OOM postmortem. We have recurring small-frag retention + shard residency creep. Need owners for three buckets: immediate guards, diagnostics/artifacts, and refactor work. Please claim.

mike: I'll handle immediate guards: re-enable shard soft-cap at 92%, tighten eviction heuristics for small objects, and roll a canary. ETA 2h.

leigh: I'll own diagnostics and artifacts. Plan: collect heap samples, allocation stack traces, and comparison diffs across the last two incidents. Upload to s3 and add links to PI-2472.

leigh: Commands I'll run:
```sh
# snapshot + upload
./kvd-tool snapshot --all --out=/tmp/kvd-snap-$(date +%s).prof
aws s3 cp /tmp/kvd-snap-*.prof s3://redwood-debug/kv/2789999999/
```

sriram: I'll take allocator/GC experiments. Short plan: run canary with deferred-free and bump gc-threshold; measure pause/p99 and residency. Will open an RFC/experiment page. ETA EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started by mike (deploy/kv-served v3.2.4-guardrail).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary healthy at 3/3 hosts after 18m. No new OOMs observed.

anya: Ownership map: mike=short-term guards + telemetry, leigh=forensics + dashboards, sriram=allocator experiments + RFC, anya=postmortem writeup and long-term refactor prioritization.

mike: I'll add per-shard eviction counters and a residency heatmap tile. Also creating alert: frag_ratio > 0.38 for 15m OR pooled_buffers > 4k pages oncall. ETA for dashboards: Thu.

leigh: Early heap snapshots show many tiny buffer allocations retained in put_batch and transport copy paths; frag_ratio ~0.44 on affected nodes. I'll attach allocation flamegraph to the ticket.

anya: Please cross-reference with Feb and Mar incidents in PI-2472 and call out the differences in growth rate and allocation sites.

sriram: If pool drain doesn't fix it, proposal: add cap on pooled buffer count and an idle drain path. Prototype branch ETA next Wed.

anya: Also add a recurring weekly "kv frag audit" to ops calendar and a synthetic test that stresses small allocations. Owner: leigh (tests + dashboards) + mike (alerts). ETA next Mon.

leigh: Claiming synthetic test for TestGrid. ETA Mon.

mike: Claiming eviction telemetry + alert tuning. ETA Thu.

sriram: Claiming allocator prototype and microbench results. ETA Wed.

anya: Thanks. Keep this thread for short updates; long notes and all artifacts go into PI-2472. If you pick subtasks, reply with one-line claim + ETA. Closing for now. :memo:
